description: Department of Local Government -  North Central Province - Published Regulations pertaining allowances to the members of P/S
categorisation: This gazette content establishes regulations for various allowances (fuel, travelling, subsistence, refreshment, telephone, attendance) for elected officials (Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Members) and their staff in Municipal Councils and Pradeshiya Sabhas. This pertains to public sector service conditions, benefits, and administrative instructions for local government officials, which falls under the Public Service classification. While a government official (the Governor) is named, the content's primary purpose is not about the personnel change or their portfolio but about setting administrative rules for public servants, making Type 8 the most appropriate category.
